data.camera: cowboy shot, practicing sword drills on the training ground
data.description: 落日将训练场的木桩染成金色，艾莉丝挥剑的剪影一次比一次果断，汗珠顺着下颚滑落，深红发丝贴在颊边——「今天的千次，还差一百。」
data.promptProse: With both hands on the hilt, she follows through a deliberate sword arc between the training posts. Sunset rims her red hair and lights the sweat at her jaw.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 挥剑千次
data.animaCaption: Both hands guide a deliberate sword arc between the training posts.
